body.name: Explicit seven-cell endpoint and branch maps
body.construction: For \(z\in\operatorname{int}(\Delta_6)\), use the coordinates in \(\psi(z)\) and the affine pieces \(u_{K0},u_{K1},d_{K0},d_{K1}\) from \(\mathrm{def{:}rational\text{-}branch\text{-}family}\). For every \(\beta\in\{0,1\}^6\) and \(\ell\in\{0,1\}\), set \(\widetilde r_{\ell\beta}^+(z)=e_\ell(z)p_\ell(z)+\{1-e_\ell(z)\}u_{G,\beta_\ell}(p_\ell(z))\), \(\widetilde t_{\ell\beta}^+(z)=u_{B,\beta_{2+\ell}}(\widetilde r_{\ell\beta}^+(z))\), \(\widetilde r_{\ell\beta}^-(z)=e_\ell(z)p_\ell(z)+\{1-e_\ell(z)\}d_{G,\beta_\ell}(p_\ell(z))\), and \(\widetilde t_{\ell\beta}^-(z)=d_{B,\beta_{2+\ell}}(\widetilde r_{\ell\beta}^-(z))\). Put \(\widetilde h_\beta(z)=d_{C,\beta_5}(q_0(z))\) if \(\beta_4=0\), and \(\widetilde h_\beta(z)=u_{C,\beta_5}(q_0(z))\) if \(\beta_4=1\). For \(s\in\{-,+\}\), define the rational map \(\widetilde f_\beta^s(z)=a(z)\sum_{\ell=0}^1q_\ell(z)\widetilde r_{\ell\beta}^s(z)+(1-a(z))\{\widetilde h_\beta(z)\widetilde t_{0\beta}^s(z)+(1-\widetilde h_\beta(z))\widetilde t_{1\beta}^s(z)\}\). Also define \(\widetilde r_\ell^+(z)=e_\ell(z)p_\ell(z)+\{1-e_\ell(z)\}U_G(p_\ell(z))\), \(\widetilde r_\ell^-(z)=e_\ell(z)p_\ell(z)+\{1-e_\ell(z)\}D_G(p_\ell(z))\), \(\widetilde t_\ell^+(z)=U_B(\widetilde r_\ell^+(z))\), \(\widetilde t_\ell^-(z)=D_B(\widetilde r_\ell^-(z))\), \(\widetilde h^-(z)=D_C(q_0(z))\), and \(\widetilde h^+(z)=U_C(q_0(z))\). The endpoint maps are \(\widetilde F_+(z)=a(z)\sum_{\ell=0}^1q_\ell(z)\widetilde r_\ell^+(z)+\{1-a(z)\}\max_{h\in\{\widetilde h^-(z),\widetilde h^+(z)\}}\{h\widetilde t_0^+(z)+(1-h)\widetilde t_1^+(z)\}\) and \(\widetilde F_-(z)=a(z)\sum_{\ell=0}^1q_\ell(z)\widetilde r_\ell^-(z)+\{1-a(z)\}\min_{h\in\{\widetilde h^-(z),\widetilde h^+(z)\}}\{h\widetilde t_0^-(z)+(1-h)\widetilde t_1^-(z)\}\).
